## Related approved issue

Reference the executable issue, not only the roadmap parent.

## Behavior changed

Describe the user-visible change and what is deliberately unchanged.

## Verification evidence

Record commands and results actually obtained. Name the operating system,
architecture, installed Codex version where relevant, and any untested behavior.
A fake-Codex test is not live-account qualification.

## Privacy and compatibility

Describe credential, local-state, export, migration, CLI/JSON, and workflow impact.
Use synthetic fixtures. Do not paste private logs or account data.

## Checklist

- [ ] My commits have valid DCO sign-offs.
- [ ] Tests and documentation match the changed behavior.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private data, or unreviewed generated archives.
- [ ] I stated remaining limitations and did not claim tests I did not run.
